name: shapez.io
tagline: The factory lives in the GIF. One invite, and a friend is on the same belts.
description:
shapez.io on the web is a tab that forgets you. This copy keeps the factory inside the file — close it, come back, every belt and machine is where you left it. Send Invite and a friend builds on that same floor with you. No account, no install, it works on a plane.

Extract circles and rectangles, belt them in, cut them in half, rotate the pieces, paint them red or blue. The hub asks for a new shape each level and unlocks the next machine. This is the opening of shapez — extractor, belt, cutter, rotator, painter — not the 26-level wires-and-stackers campaign.

An unofficial port of shapez by tobspr Games, GPL-3.0. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
